You see a war hammer (Atk:45, Def:10).
Imbuements: (Empty Slot, Empty Slot, Empty Slot).
Classification: 1 Tier: 0.
It can only be wielded properly by knights of level 50 or higher.
It weighs 85.00 oz.

    Notes

    Used to be used by most club fighters to cause heavy damage. Has lost most of its usefulness since the Summer Update 2007, since the level required for proper use is now 50. It looks the same as a Worm Punisher. Obtainable from the Circle Room Quest.

    Weapon Proficiency

    1 2 3
    +1 defence
    +4% of your Club Fighting as extra damage for auto-attacks
    +1% critical hit chance for auto-attacks
    +5 hit points on kill

    History

    From Christmas Update 2007 until Summer Update 2017, it could be transformed into the following Enchanted Weapons through the process known as Enchanting:

    • Icy War Hammer
    • Earth War Hammer
    • Energy War Hammer
    • Fiery War Hammer

    These sprites are now used for their respective replicas.
